text: Guderley converging shock: lightweight spherical-radial verification HLL plus Heun follows a Guderley shock into stationary zero-pressure upstream gas at gamma=1.4, r in [0,0.75], t=-1 to -0.85 on 128/256/512 shells. Initialize the similarity field with Rs(-1)=0.6 and compare the pre-collapse trajectory, conserved shell means and budgets with a semi-analytic reference. The figure is a 2D section display of 1D radial results. These additional validation supplements are managed separately from the common 22-example registry. Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Routine supplement CI runs the supplement groups listed in the public registry with NumPy,SciPy and pytest. It checks versions,inputs and execution records for stored independent references and distinguishes their reuse from new reference computations. The existing common22-case suite,including quantum convergence,remains manual on explicit need; released artifacts,criteria and history are preserved. Download and execute the supplement Run inside atlas-guderley-2026-11-23-r3 from the ZIP. This command executes all 1 fixed cases in the supplement. Choose a new or empty output directory. python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python -m pytest -q python run.py --input inputs.json --output output Matplotlib is optional for redrawing saved figures; ordinary scientific execution does not require it. Guderley converging shock: lightweight spherical-radial verification An inward spherical Guderley shock in cold stationary gas is evolved from t=-1 to -0.85 on 128/256/512 radial shells. HLL fluxes and Heun steps are checked against a similarity eigenvalue/field, shock trajectory and discrete conservation budgets. Methods, equations, figures and references Assumptions, units and boundaries Fix gamma=1.4, three-dimensional spherical symmetry on r in [0,0.75], Rs(-1)=0.6 and t in [-1,-0.85]. Ahead of the inward shock the inner gas is exactly rho0=1,u0=p0=0. The outer region already contains the shocked similarity field; the entire initial domain is not a uniform cold state. Initial conserved shell means use order16 Gauss integration split at the exact shock, checked against order32. Reference pressure is p(mean conserved state), not mean primitive pressure. Editorial clarification The pre-collapse branch of the spherical Guderley similarity solution at gamma=1.4 with a cold uniform upstream state. Numerical eigenvalue shooting, similarity-ODE integration and shock-split shell quadrature make this a semi-analytic reference, not closed-form exact cell means. Distinguish the ExactPack-based evaluator from the finite-volume PDE calculation; this is not a comparison between independent similarity implementations. Collapse at the origin, the reflected branch and general equations of state are outside this example. Full-volume density/pressure L1 and the predetermined r>=0.8*Rs active-region L1 decrease across the three grids, but shock-layer density/pressure Linf and shock-location error in cell widths do not decrease monotonically. No collapse or high-order shock-detail convergence is claimed. Minimum raw internal-energy density was 0, including the cold upstream, and the sound-speed square-root guard was used zero times in all three runs. Routine replay reuses lambda qualified by the retained eigenvalue shooting and eight original ExactPack probes, while freshly integrating the similarity ODE, shell quadrature and Euler evolution. Recomputing the eigenvalue/original-source probes is a separate explicit command. The r2 public Linux replay passed 33 tests before reaching the unchanged 120-second group limit; its failure record is retained, with physical inputs and acceptance criteria preserved for the lighter routine replay. Adopted numerical method First-order spherical finite volumes use face area4pi*r^2 and shell volume4pi*delta(r^3)/3. Shared HLL flux divergence plus the radial-momentum pressure source p_i*delta(A)/V is advanced by Heun at CFL0.4. The center is reflecting with zero face area; the outer similarity state is evaluated at both actual RK times. All three conserved budgets integrate the actual boundary flux and geometric source using the same Heun weights. Checks cover the zero-sound-speed cold HLL branch, geometric static-pressure balance, shared-flux budgets, actual two-stage boundary times and raw failed-stage retention. Full-volume L1 is shown alongside the predetermined r>=0.8*Rs shock/nonzero-flow region, so cold inner gas does not hide active errors. Maximum density/pressure differences and the saved shock trajectory remain visible. The semi-analytic reference uses the pinned LANL ExactPack eigenvalue routine and ODE through a cached pre-collapse-only adapter. It is not an independently reimplemented similarity ODE; the separately implemented finite-volume Euler evolution is compared against that reference. Full-volume density L1 is0.02345/0.01339/0.007722 and pressure L1 is0.03277/0.01743/0.009477. Density L1 in the predetermined r>=0.8*Rs region also decreases:0.02414/0.01378/0.007948. The finest measured shock radius is0.530273 against similarity0.533989, about2.54 cells apart. The maximum scaled three-component budget residual is8.85e-16. Minimum internal energy and sound-speed-only roundoff guard evaluations are both0. The smooth-reference Euler finite-difference residual is8.24e-9 and finite-offset moving-jump residual4.40e-8. The older three-run execution with a newly computed similarity eigenvalue took about44.6 seconds on the original Mac. Public r2 passed all33 Linux tests in96.34 seconds, but its fixed-input runner timed out after the remaining23.31 seconds of the combined120-second test-plus-run budget. That failed replay and its sources are retained. The revision reuses the eigenvalue already obtained by actual ExactPack shooting, bound by SHA to its source and qualification, instead of shooting again in both normal processes. The critical-phase Cdiff residual and similarity ODE are freshly evaluated. Inputs, numerical criteria, Euler solver, fixed-input runner and120-second budget are unchanged. In the revision,33 unit tests and all three fixed inputs with55 gates completed sequentially within one120-second budget in about0.912s on the Mac. Initial,final,reference and saved-history arrays for all three grids were bit-identical to published r2, separately checking that reuse of the eigenvalue preserved the physical results. Verification limits and failures This is a short one-dimensional spherical verification away from collapse t=0. The singular origin, reflected branch, cylindrical geometry, other gammas and nonspherical perturbation stability are untested. Two-dimensional pictures map saved spherical shell means onto a meridional plane; they are not Cartesian2D evolution. The semi-analytic field is a numerically evaluated ODE/quadrature reference, not a closed-form exact cell average. Zero pressure is allowed in the cold upstream; cancellation-band negative internal energy density down to an absolute64eps is recorded. Sound-speed square-root guards only within that band have separate counts/minimum raw pressure and do not repair the state. No general nonlinear positivity theorem is claimed. Shock-position error in cell units does not decrease monotonically:1.13/2.27/2.54. Absolute radius error is about0.00665 for the first two grids and0.00372 for the finest. Density Linf differences0.258/0.271/0.266 and pressure Linf0.492/0.494/0.466 are also not monotonically decreasing. L1 reduction is not evidence that the discontinuity is pointwise resolved or that the collapse region converges. Stored measurements and decisions Display values are rounded.
